summary: Tested WHOOP-inspired sleep analysis features in health-detail.tsx. Backend APIs (/api/health/sleep/analysis, /api/health/sleep/history) working correctly. Frontend renders all WHOOP components: performance score ring, 4 sub-scores, recovery card, weekly trend chart, sleep planner, hypnogram, apnea risk. Navigation from SleepCard to sleep detail page works. Auto-date selection correctly picks March 17 (latest date with data).

issues: Frontend calculates debt using effective sleep (deep+light+rem) = 18h46m, while backend API returns debt using total duration = 9h24m. This is a design inconsistency, not a bug - frontend approach is more accurate but differs from API.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Align frontend debt calculation with backend API (use sleepAnalysis.debt.total_min instead of recalculating from history)
critical_code_review_comments: health-detail.tsx line 433: Frontend calculates weekDebtMin from sleepData (deep+light+rem) which differs from backend calculation using duration. Consider using sleepAnalysis.debt.total_min for consistency.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing sleep data from March 11-17, 2026
